title: 인쇄
description: File ▸ Print (Layout ▸ Pages ▸ Print Pages: opened with values {pageIds}; File ▸ Print Presets ▸ <preset>: with {preset}; Flattener Preview ▸ Apply Settings to Print: with {flattenerPresetName, ignoreSpreadOverrides}): the open document's print. preset is [Default] or one of the user's print presets (app settings printPresets) and fills the settings; a setting changed makes it [Custom] (__custom). The settings are a print preset's (printPresets shares the fields, on InDesign's pages General … Advanced and Summary); a setting that does not apply to the values is off (off says why; the engine works it out after each change). range is all, range (rangeText, a page range as InDesign's print takes it, like +2-+5) or pages (the pages pageIds names). The plan (dialogPreview: printingPlan's sheets) follows the values; OK and print wait for it. OK (Save PDF Proof) writes the sheets into path (a whole .pdf path in a folder that exists; the screen fills it from the system's save window) with printingFile and closes. print sends the same sheets to device (one of listPrinters) with printToDevice and stays open with the job it made (sent); cancelJob takes it back (cancelPrintJob). namePreset shows newName; savePreset saves the settings as a new print preset of that name (userSettings patch printPresets) and stays open with it chosen. Over an attached MCP connection the dialog is filled and read but not applied (it writes a file or prints).
